# Doefin

> Open Bitcoin mining difficulty data. Forward forecasts with fitted confidence
> intervals, a public accuracy scoreboard scoring every estimator including our own,
> and the research behind both. Published by Predexyo UK Ltd.

Doefin publishes difficulty forecasts as reproducible arithmetic over public chain
data. The method is versioned and every restatement is logged. Figures are HTML text
with their date and units, never chart-only.

## Data

- [Difficulty forecast](https://doefin.com/data/difficulty): current forward forecast with its 95% interval and the probability the sign is wrong
- [Accuracy scoreboard](https://doefin.com/data/scoreboard): every public estimator scored on realised error and interval coverage
- [Epoch archive](https://doefin.com/data/difficulty): one permanent dated page per adjustment — forecast, band, and realised outcome
- [Methodology](https://doefin.com/methodology/difficulty-index): the arithmetic, the fit window, the restatement log

## Reference

- [Glossary](https://doefin.com/glossary): every term in mining difficulty and hashrate economics, defined once
- [Learn](https://doefin.com/academy): how difficulty adjustment works, what hashprice measures, why forecasts need error bars
- [Research](https://doefin.com/research): original analysis, published in full and free

## Attribution

Data is free to use. We ask for a link back and that the metric is named as published,
so unlinked mentions stay attributable.

## Note

Doefin is a venue for Bitcoin difficulty derivatives, available to professional
investors only. Nothing published is investment advice.
